The set is delivered in an exclusive & eye-catching presentation box produced from used plastic bottles. Only chemically inert recycled plastic waste was selected as part of the process. The box is created in 4 steps: • Use plastic bottles are collected. • The plastic bottles are then shredded into small pieces. • The pieces are selectively hand arranged & then pressed into a panel.
